name: xcreener-mcp
description: Scans Crypto, Forex, Indices, Commodities, and Metals to spot breakouts, momentum, and key levels in seconds — built for your first trade and your AI agent.
long_description: XCREENER scans Crypto, Forex, Indices, Commodities, and Metals simultaneously, so you don't have to check charts one at a time. It's built for beginner traders through ready-made screeners as well as for developers and AI agents, who can express custom conditions in XQL. This extension brings that straight into Claude: ask in plain English, and it validates, explains, or runs the XQL query against live market data for you.

tools.name: xql_explain
tools.description: Return an XQL query's execution plan

tools.name: xql_run
tools.description: Execute an XQL query against live market data

prompts.name: translate_query
prompts.text: Using the XQL natural-language reference, translate this into a valid XQL query, then call xql_validate before xql_run: ${arguments.humanQuery}
